race.comment: OUR PIERRO (4) is the horse to beat after a sound return at Kyneton, where she was sixth in a BM62 and beaten only two lengths after being bumped on jumping. The drop into BM56 grade, the 2kg claim are big ticks and with the winkers on for the first time, she can get back to winning ways. IT'S GNARLY (9) is the clear danger after finishing fourth at Bendigo, beaten just under two lengths in an open market, and the return of Ryan Houston is a genuine plus given their one win from four starts together. ALEXANDER THEGREAT (2) has more upside than most, with a 1500m debut win already on the page and scope to improve second-up after a CL1 fifth at this track. RUSSIAN BENEFITS (8) has been close enough in two runs this campaign and owns two wins from five starts at this track, though 1500m is new territory after two 1200m runs. CHAMBERS BAY (5) can improve on his last start performance.
